g.title: Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Inject Input into Server Interpreters An anonymous caller requests GET /rest/products/search with a crafted q parameter such as qwert')) UNION SELECT id,email,password,... FROM Users--. At routes/search.ts:23 the q value is interpolated directly into a raw sequelize SELECT statement, so the attacker can append arbitrary SQL and read any table in the SQLite database, including the schema and every user's e-mail address and password hash, which come back in the JSON product list. Interpolating request-controlled text into SQL can also allow modifying rows or escalating to database control. The only control is a 200-character truncation at line 22, with no escaping or binding, and the route is registered without authentication at server.ts:602. C-05 · Juice Shop Express API No account required Database access relies on concatenated queries (W-003) Technical consequence not established. Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data Disclosure of customer information

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Bypass or Forge Authentication POST /rest/chat has no route guard (server.ts:638). getUserId reads the bearer token with security.decode (jws.decode), which never checks the signature. An attacker can forge a token with data.id set to the victim's id. getOrderById then compares the order email against the victim's masked email, so the attacker can ask for the victim's orders. The victim's username is also placed in the system prompt. ASI03: the agent acts under an identity that was never authenticated. C-05 · Juice Shop Express API No account required Authentication relies on hand-rolled token verification (W-004) Technical consequence not established. Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Bypass Authorization to Gain Access An authenticated user supplies another user's object id to handlers that check authentication but not ownership. PUT /rest/basket/:id/coupon/:coupon at routes/coupon.ts:18 calls BasketModel.findByPk(params.id) and overwrites the coupon on any user's basket. PUT /api/Addresss/:id at server.ts:450 registers only appendUserId and falls through to the generic finale Address resource (server.ts:493), which updates by id without scoping to UserId, unlike getAddressById and delAddressById, so a user could overwrite another user's address and reassign it to themselves. POST /rest/basket/{victimBasketId}/checkout reaches placeOrder at routes/order.ts:35, which loads the basket by path id only, creates an order from the victim's items and destroys the victim's basket items. A PATCH of another user's review id at routes/updateProductReviews.ts:17 resolves the user but omits the author from the update filter, so reviews attributed to others are rewritten. PUT /api/BasketItems/:id at server.ts:426 and GET /rest/basket/:id at server.ts:603 load a resource by a request-supplied id with no ownership predicate. isAuthorized and appendUserId (server.ts:356, 399) require a valid JWT but do not bind the ids to that user. The finding holds 8 places, more than the parts' cited locations. C-05 · Juice Shop Express API No account required Authorization is implemented route by route (W-006) Technical consequence not established. Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data Disclosure of customer information

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Access Exposed Data and Secrets An authenticated caller posts a layout value such as a ../ path to /dataerasure. At routes/dataErasure.ts:104 the handler resolves that value to an absolute path and, unless it contains ftp, ctf.key or encryptionkeys, renders it as the response layout, returning the first 100 characters of the rendered file and so reading files outside the view directory, such as source or secrets. One part describes the generic risk of a request-controlled path as reading arbitrary files or writing outside the intended root; the other part shows only the read through layout rendering. The only control is the three-substring deny-list, with no base-directory containment check and no allow-list. C-05 · Juice Shop Express API No account required No weakness linked in the register Technical consequence not established. Disclosure of customer information

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Stored username evaluated as server code I register an account and POST /profile with username=#{global.process.mainModule.require('child_process').execSync('id').toString()}. C-05 · Juice Shop Express API Regular account required Application data crosses into executable code (W-001) Technical consequence not established. Service disruption or compromise of application data

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Inject Scripts into Victim Browsers I craft a URL to /#/search with q set to an HTML payload containing a javascript: iframe or an event handler. C-03 · Angular Frontend Client Victim interaction required Frontend rendering lacks enforced output encoding (W-008) Technical consequence not established. Customer account misuse and disclosure of private account data

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Abuse Cross-Site Requests googleLogin at frontend/src/app/login/login.component.ts:148 builds an authorization URL with response_type=token and no state or nonce, so the callback cannot bind the response to the initiating session. An attacker starts their own Google implicit-flow login and gets the victim's browser to open the app's callback with the attacker's #access_token fragment, for example through a crafted link. The app accepts the token and signs the victim into the attacker's account (login CSRF or token injection). The access token in the URL fragment can also leak through history. The redirect URI is matched against a configured allow-list (login.component.ts:80). C-03 · Angular Frontend Client Victim interaction required OAuth sign-in requests are not bound to the user's browser session (W-020) Cookie-authenticated changes lack request authenticity checks (W-021) Technical consequence not established. Customer account misuse and disclosure of private account data

Supply-Chain / Build Attacker 1 role; access details in Identified Actors Compromise the Build or Its Inputs Dependency Install Scripts Run at Build Time: Without --ignore-scripts, any compromised dependency publisher can execute postinstall code at build time. C-01 · CI/CD Pipeline Build or dependency access required No weakness linked in the register Technical consequence not established. Service disruption or compromise of application data Disclosure of customer information
g.text: Compromise the Build or Its Inputs
